719-2638-3510-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-2638-3510-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

628-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

277-2557-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3941-4331-4993-7913.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
Repeat.

1671-2248-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6824-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6824-7818.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1409-3099-3755-6968.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3963.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3194-3963.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Meneldor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3490-4050-4369-7278.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4369-7278.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Slash triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

339-677-6965-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-6965-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

628-2034-7197.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

648-7066.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each card in your library.
Cast The Legend of Kyoshi by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When The Legend of Kyoshi enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, thus drawing your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control

515-1636-4178.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Nissa, Who Shakes the World.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-1987-2585-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3693-4613-4772-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Doubling Season.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2511-3817-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

478-804-2416-2821-6745.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2416-2821-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-2416-2821-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Rise and Shine.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

325-2275-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2275-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

92-1745-3392.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3188-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

940-4067-5806.notablePrerequisites:
Thieving Otter does not have summoning sickness.
Arcane Teachings attached to Thieving Otter.
940-4067-5806.description:
Activate Thieving Otter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Thieving Otter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thieving Otter.
Repeat.

628-2393-3944-4417.notablePrerequisites: Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2393-3944-4417.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Blood Pet trigger, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Blood Pet, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

914-2292-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2292-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1584-1719-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1584-1719-3525.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.

1987-2556-3075-5116.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-2556-3075-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

3116-3846.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
At least one of your opponents is unable to block Atemsis.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You have at least one white card, blue card, black card, red card, and green card in library that together do not share a mana value with each other or at least one of the additional cards in hand.
3116-3846.description:
Cast Conflux, searching your library for a white card, blue card, black card, red card, and green card in your library that together do not share a mana value with each other or at least one of the additional cards in your hand.
Attack an opponent who is unable to block Atemsis with Atemsis.
On damage, Atemsis triggers, allowing you to reveal your hand and losing that player the game.
